values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Rustic state forest campground on Healy Lake, about 7.5 mi SW of Copemish (Manistee County), managed by Springdale Township. Sandy swimming beach and a boat ramp on the lake. Open about May 1 to Oct 31. A reviewer reports a 22-ft rig fit and large sites that could take a 30-ft trailer. --Claude
summary: DNR page: 24 tent/small-trailer sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport (fees, previously only inherited, now on the entry), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, ramp, first-come only, 15-day maximum (confirmed). Managed by Springdale Township. No season statement (not on the DNR amenity table). Note trimmed of field restatements and the stale phone caveat.
flags: Phone: the DNR page gives 231-378-2252 for Springdale Township, the manager ('Any concerns or questions about this campground should be directed to the Township at the phone number identified above'); the entry has 231-864-2531.

Healy Lake does not appear on the DNR state forest campground amenity table (https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table, 143 rows read 2026-10-25), although its recsearch page is live and describes it as an operating township-managed state forest campground; no closure notice found. Season dates are unconfirmed for that reason.
